title: IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent 8.16.0 through 8.20.3 does not validate or improperly validates TLS certificate…
description: IBM Turbonomic kubeturbo agent versions 8.16.0 through 8.20.3 have a vulnerability related to improper or absent TLS certificate validation. This flaw could allow an attacker to intercept sensitive information via man-in-the-middle attacks. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
